actions.label: Scan a package archive
actions.notes: Read-only. It inspects archive bytes and never installs anything.
actions.summary: Audit one package archive with the default deterministic rules and return the bounded report projection.

actions.label: Scan a PKGBUILD
actions.notes: Read-only. The build script is parsed, never executed.
actions.summary: Audit one PKGBUILD and its declared install hooks with the default deterministic rules.

actions.label: Open a saved report
actions.notes: Read-only. Raw package bytes and absolute paths stay out of the view.
actions.summary: Render a previously produced AuraScan JSON report.

actions.label: Refresh the evidence snapshot
actions.notes: Read-only. It runs no package manager and contacts no model.
actions.summary: Re-collect local check, detection-data and incident evidence.

actions.label: Repair missing shared libraries
actions.notes: Installs packages through sudo, so it stays in the terminal and is never requested by the renderer.
actions.summary: Scan recent package updates for missing shared libraries and offer the official provider packages.

actions.label: Repair a hung application
actions.notes: Downgrades a package through sudo, so it stays in the terminal and is never requested by the renderer.
actions.summary: Diagnose a wait-then-read pipe deadlock and offer a cached older package build.
